validation.bellisRootCheck: not-rerun; prior 1040 unit/property and 254 integration baseline, host production source unchanged

verified: Replay checks candidates and current Persona in the same read snapshot as saved-response lookup; initial publication and concurrent-winner replay check in their write transaction
Supersede, retract, expiration and Persona publication reject stale results at all three boundaries without revealing affected resource identities
Failed initial publication leaves no Recall request row; rejected replay preserves the entire original response/returned set, while a fresh independent request can read current valid resources
Authorized historical replay retains its original as_of evaluation instant; unrelated changes and fresh deadlines preserve the unchanged original result

Installed SDK 0.11.1 through checked HTTP confirms stable valid replay, public Correct while Worker stopped, rejected old Recall with 409 conflict, and unchanged original Usage report identity/stage counts
Final installation passes new-revision Context, cancellation, durable event checkpoint, deletion, gap barrier/inventory and Chromium regression; tools and existing 24-case crash smoke pass
limits: This does not create a public cross-request snapshot, inventory item verdicts, reconciled Observation/Usage authority or safe atomic history-gap release

Existing per-resource hard filters are reused; this is not independent rehashing of all persisted response bodies. Pending event identities and original watermarks are not upgraded to new consistency proofs
The real HTTP case covers Claim supersede; other changes and publication interleavings are Core integration-test cases. No new SIGKILL window or full Core regression is claimed
Default SDK 0.11.1 and default Provider Core schema window are unchanged; candidate SDK 0.11.2 is isolated for checkpoint/gap probes pending registry approval
